id: 738-卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特對科潘的戰爭
theater: 莫塔瓜河谷奇里瓜—科潘道

battle.name: 卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特對科潘的戰爭
battle.theater: 莫塔瓜河谷奇里瓜—科潘道
battle.brief: 公元738年，奇里瓜國王卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特在莫塔瓜河谷截住科潘國王瓦克薩克拉洪·烏巴·卡維爾，奪其護神木像，五月初在奇里瓜大廣場將其斬首獻祭，科潘的紀年自此空白十七年。卡面的科林斯青銅盔是公元前650年定型的地中海裝備，與瑪雅戰場並無交集；本役真正上陣的是瑪雅矛鏢、弓矢、獸首頭盔與小圓盾。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這不是國家對國家的戰爭，而是古典期瑪雅城邦聯盟內部一次政變式的戰役。交戰一方是危地馬拉扎卡帕省莫塔瓜河谷的奇里瓜，其瑪雅名記作「黑潭之地」，國王即卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特；奇里瓜的軍事核心是大廣場一組宮殿群所屬的城邦戶群，以獅虎武士與鷹系戰士為骨幹，輔以直接隸屬「神聖之君」的祭司戰士階層，以及河谷各聚落的徵發兵員。指揮體系分王、省區領主、村社頭目三層，戰時以長矛與旗幟集結隊伍，兵力估計以數百至數千人為度。另一方是洪都拉斯西部科潘河谷的科潘王國，其王瓦克薩克拉洪·烏巴·卡維爾兼稱「十八兔」，並以「偉大的君」自居，統治半徑涵蓋科潘谷地、上莫塔瓜與洪都拉斯東部平原，兵力除都城守軍外，還包括谷地屬國與東線盟邦的部隊；它曾於718年攻燒鄰近的克庫伊城。第三方是遠方的卡拉克穆爾，其君主瓦馬瓦·卡維爾於736年造訪奇里瓜，學界多認為卡拉克穆爾支持奇里瓜脫離科潘，用以削弱科潘的老盟友蒂卡爾並爭取莫塔瓜商路；其餘南方城邦多在兩強之間保持觀望。必須說明的是，古典期瑪雅並無常設常備軍與全國性兵員冊，雙方都沒有留下可核對的花名冊，所有兵力判斷只能由碑銘、壁畫與聚落規模推估。
countriesEn: This was not a war between nations but a coup-like campaign inside the network of Classic Maya city-states. One side was Quiriguá, in the Motagua valley of Zacapa department in Guatemala, whose Maya name is recorded as 'Black Hole Place', ruled by K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat. The military core of Quiriguá was the body of city households attached to the palace group of the Great Plaza, with the Jaguar warriors and the Eagle warriors of the capital as its backbone, reinforced by priest-warriors directly answerable to the 'holy lord' and by levies drawn from the villages of the valley. The chain of command ran from the ajaw through the provincial lords to the village heads, and troops were mustered around long spears and standards; the size of the force is on the order of several hundred to several thousand. The other side was the kingdom of Copán in the Copán valley of western Honduras, under Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil, who also bore the name 'Eighteen Rabbit' and styled himself 'great lord'; its sphere of control covered the Copán valley, the upper Motagua and the eastern Honduran plain, and its forces combined the capital garrison with the valley dependencies and the eastern allies, the city having attacked and burned the neighbouring Xkuy in 718. A third party was distant Calakmul, whose ruler Wamaw K'awiil visited Quiriguá in 736; most scholars read that visit as Calakmul backing Quiriguá's break with Copán in order to weaken Copán's old ally Tikal and to reach the Motagua trade route, while the remaining southern city-states watched from the sidelines. It must be stressed that the Classic Maya had no standing national armies and no roster of the realm; neither side left a list that can be checked, and every estimate of strength is an inference from inscriptions, murals and the scale of settlements.
people: 卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特，另有卡瓦克天空等譯法，於724或725年由科潘王瓦克薩克拉洪·烏巴·卡維爾扶上奇里瓜王位，當時身份是附庸；他在734年9月15日立起祭壇M，自稱「神聖之君」，並開始使用奇里瓜自己的徽記，這在瑪雅政治語彙中已構成對舊宗主的不服。736年，卡拉克穆爾的瓦馬瓦·卡維爾到訪奇里瓜，遠方強者的到訪使這位年輕君主有了外部支持，也讓科潘感到壓力。戰役本身幾乎是他個人的行動：依奇里瓜碑銘，738年4月27日，奇里瓜在科潘通往莫塔瓜河谷的道路上截住科潘王一行，奪走並焚毀科潘守護神的木雕神像；被俘的國王於5月3日在奇里瓜大廣場被公開斬首獻祭，其血被用作提高奇里瓜王族在區域內的威望。科潘方面的核心人物就是瓦克薩克拉洪·烏巴·卡維爾本人，他自628年即位，在位約六十年；科潘聖石9與10，以及736年的聖石D，都把他表現成武裝君主，738年的聖石5則是這條王朝有紀年碑刻的最後一座。執行方應是奇里瓜王都直屬的精銳隊伍，加上分佈在莫塔瓜河與胡布科河入谷口的哨所守兵，並可能有卡拉克穆爾的援軍；隨行的祭司把整套儀式帶到現場，包括抬載神像的轎架，以及在戰場上指揮集結的旗手。戰後奇里瓜工匠在本地仿製科潘風格的巨型石碑，專家認為其中徵用了科潘的雕刻匠人。
peopleEn: K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat, also translated as Cauac Sky or Kawak Sky, was placed on the throne of Quiriguá in 724 or 725 by the Copán king Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil, and at that time as a vassal; on 15 September 734 he set up Altar M and styled himself k'uhul ajaw, 'holy lord', and began to use Quiriguá's own emblem glyph, which in Maya political vocabulary already amounted to a repudiation of his old overlord. In 736 Wamaw K'awiil of Calakmul visited Quiriguá; the arrival of a distant power gave this young ruler external backing and made Copán feel the pressure. The campaign itself was very largely the work of this one man: according to the Quiriguá inscription, on 27 April 738 Quiriguá intercepted the Copán ruler and his party on the road into the Motagua valley, seized and burned the wooden images of Copán's patron deities, and the captive lord was beheaded in a public ritual in the Great Plaza of Quiriguá on 3 May 738, his blood being used to raise the standing of the Quiriguá dynasty across the region. The central figure on the Copán side was that same king, Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil, who had taken the throne in 628 and ruled for roughly sixty years; Copán Stelae 9 and 10 and Stela D of 736 all present him as an armed ruler, and Stela 5 of 738 is the last dated monument of that dynasty. On the Quiriguá side the operation was carried out by the capital's own picked troops, by the garrisons of the watchposts where the Motagua and Jubuco rivers enter the valley, and probably with Calakmul auxiliaries; the ritual specialists went with them, with the litters that carried the images of the gods and the standard-bearers who directed the mustering on the field. After the victory, Quiriguá craftsmen reproduced Copán's monumental style on local stone, and specialists believe captured Copán sculptors were put to work on it.
kits: 本役戰場上沒有任何金屬盔甲。瑪雅士兵的防護是皮革或木胎綴羽的小圓盾，近戰用石斧與插有黑曜石刃的棍棒，遠射用投槍器配標槍，後晚期亦有弓矢；精銳的金印武士配戴以紙、藤、羽毛與獸皮製成的頭盔，頂端有獸首與羽冠，另有以虎皮為面、綴滿小鏡片的華麗頭套，犧牲視野與聽覺以換取威勢，攻城與野戰的門面完全依靠隊形、旗幟與口耳傳令維持。卡面的科林斯青銅盔屬完全不同的技術系統：它定型於公元前650年前後的希臘世界，原料為青銅，形式是整塊殼體連面部開眼與鼻樑，一具重數公斤；到738年，它在地中海本身亦早被科爾基迪昂式半盔與後來的伊特利亞式頭盔取代，在中美洲更是從未出現。它在本役的位置只能視為類比物：其「以視野換防護」的取捨，在瑪雅那邊對應的正是獸首頭盔加小圓盾的組合，兩者都把個人防護壓到最低，逼迫士兵靠密集隊形與旗幟維持戰線，而奇里瓜這場戰役恰恰是靠一次精準伏擊、而不是靠正面消耗取勝。實際留下來的器物證據包括奇里瓜780年巨獸像B奠基坑中七片長十四至四十六釐米的燧石刃，以及兩地碑刻上作為戰利品符號出現的長矛、盾牌與短矛。
kitsEn: No metal armour stood on this battlefield. Maya soldiers were protected by small round shields of hide or wood faced with featherwork; they carried flaked-stone axes and clubs inset with obsidian blades for close work, an atlatl with darts for the longer range, and, in the later period, the bow and arrow. Elite K'inich warriors wore helmets of paper, vine, feather and animal hide topped with an animal head and a crest, together with magnificent jaguar-skin headgear studded with small mirrors, trading sight and hearing for awe, and the line itself was held up by formation, standards and shouted relays rather than by any armour. The Corinthian helmet on the card belongs to a wholly different technological system: it was fixed in form around 650 BC in the Greek world, its material is bronze, and it is a single shell with the face opened for the eyes and a nasal guard, a helmet weighing several kilograms. By 738 it had long been superseded in the Mediterranean itself by Chalcidian half-helmets and later Italic types, and in Mesoamerica it had never existed at all. Its place in this campaign can only be taken as an analogy: the trade of field of view against protection has its Maya counterpart in the pairing of the animal-head helmet with the small round shield, and both push individual protection down to a minimum, forcing soldiers to hold the line by dense formation and by the standards of the commanders; Quiriguá in any case won here by a precise ambush rather than by frontal attrition. The material evidence that actually survives includes the seven flint blades, 14 to 46 centimetres long, cached in the dedication pit of Zoomorph B at Quiriguá in 780, together with the spears, shields and short darts that appear on the monuments of both cities as tokens of war.
tactics: 奇里瓜的取勝方式不是攻城，而是截擊。碑銘所記的日期為738年4月27日，行動落在瑪雅傳統的乾季末段，那時雨季道路泥濘、溪流暴漲，遠征與補給都極困難。奇里瓜的守備體系沿莫塔瓜河與胡布科河的入谷口設有哨所，編號011與057，其中057一處正落在通往科潘的常用路線上，負責監視過往的隊伍。伏擊的目標是人而不是城：專家推測科潘王可能正率隊前往攻擊另一座城邦以取得可獻祭的俘虜，途中被奇里瓜軍隊截住；神像由轎架抬著同行，一旦統帥被擒，神像與隊伍同時失去核心。奇里瓜得手後並未進攻科潘城，現有考古證據顯示兩城都沒有遭到軍事破壞，而是立刻轉向控制莫塔瓜河谷的商路與附庸，762年由卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特主持，把旭日美洲虎送上克庫伊的王位；同時重建大廣場，把科潘的球場樣式與浮雕風格整套搬過來，約750年前後立起金印王之牆。若說戰術結構，這是一次以政治綁架代替會戰的典型瑪雅式攻勢。
tacticsEn: Quiriguá did not win by siege but by interception. The date in the inscription is 27 April 738, which places the operation in the closing stretch of the Maya dry season, when muddy roads and swollen streams make campaigning and supply extremely hard. Quiriguá's defensive system included watchposts where the Motagua and the Jubuco rivers enter the valley, numbered 011 and 057; 057 lay on the usual road to Copán and watched the columns that passed. The target was the man and not the city: specialists suggest that the Copán king may have been leading a force against another city-state in order to take captives for sacrifice, and was intercepted on the road by Quiriguá's warriors; the deity images travelled with the column on litters, and once the commander was taken the images and the army lost their centre at the same moment. After the coup Quiriguá did not attack Copán, and the archaeological evidence shows that neither city suffered military destruction; instead it turned at once to the Motagua trade route and its dependencies, and in 762 K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat supervised the accession of Sunraiser Jaguar to the throne of Xkuy. At the same time the Great Plaza was rebuilt, the Copán ballcourt model and sculptural manner brought over wholesale, and the K'inich Ahau Wall raised around 750. Structurally, this was a classic Maya offensive in which political abduction replaced pitched battle.
data: 與本役直接相關而可核對的數字有幾組。時間線：718年科潘王攻燒克庫伊；724或725年卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特被扶上奇里瓜王位；734年9月15日祭壇M上自號神聖之君；736年卡拉克穆爾的瓦馬瓦·卡維爾到訪奇里瓜；738年4月27日科潘王被俘、護神木像被毀；738年5月3日在奇里瓜大廣場公開斬首獻祭；761年聖石F、771年聖石E、775年聖石A與C、780年巨獸像B先後立成；785年7月27日卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特去世，死後第十日入葬；810年奇里瓜刻出最後一批象形文字。距離與尺度：奇里瓜與科潘直線距離約六十公里，沿莫塔瓜河谷可通；奇里瓜大廣場南北長三百二十五公尺，是瑪雅區域最大的廣場；聖石E通高十點六公尺、埋入地下部分近三公尺、重約六十五噸，是新世界最大的獨立加工巨石；聖石F高七點三公尺，761年立成時是瑪雅世界最高的碑；金印王之牆長二十三公尺、厚一點五公尺，約750年完成；奇里瓜碑石取自五公里外的採石場。人口：奇里瓜全城人口估計從未超過二千人，但738年後莫塔瓜河谷人口迅速上升；科潘谷地全境人口多估在兩萬至三萬之間。碑刻尺度可作參照：780年巨獸像B的奠基坑內藏有七片長十四至四十六公分的燧石刃。至於雙方投入的兵力，古典期瑪雅沒有留下可核對的名冊，只能由聚落規模與碑銘推估，故此處不給確數。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked for this campaign fall into a few groups. Timeline: 718, the king of Copán attacks and burns Xkuy; 724 or 725, K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat is installed on the Quiriguá throne; 15 September 734, the k'uhul ajaw title is claimed on Altar M; 736, Wamaw K'awiil of Calakmul visits Quiriguá; 27 April 738, the Copán king is captured and the wooden images of his patron deities are destroyed; 3 May 738, the captive is beheaded in a public ritual in the Great Plaza of Quiriguá; 761, Stela F; 771, Stela E; 775, Stelae A and C; 780, Zoomorph B; 785, on 27 July K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat dies and is buried ten days later; 810, the last hieroglyphic texts are raised at Quiriguá. Distance and scale: Quiriguá and Copán lie about sixty kilometres apart in a straight line and are joined along the Motagua valley; the Great Plaza of Quiriguá measures 325 metres north to south and is the largest plaza in the Maya region; Stela E stands 10.6 metres high including nearly 3 metres buried, and weighs about 65 tonnes, making it the largest worked free-standing monolith in the New World; Stela F, 7.3 metres high, was the tallest Maya monument when raised in 761; the K'inich Ahau Wall is 23 metres long and 1.5 metres thick and was finished around 750; the stelae were quarried five kilometres away. Population: the population of Quiriguá itself probably never exceeded two thousand, but after 738 the population of the Motagua valley rose quickly; the total population of the Copán valley is generally estimated at between twenty thousand and thirty thousand. Inscriptional scale gives a benchmark: the dedication pit of Zoomorph B of 780 held seven flint blades between 14 and 46 centimetres long. As for the troops committed, the Classic Maya left no roster that can be checked, and the strength can only be inferred from settlement size and inscriptions, so no exact figure is given here.
cause: 直接起因是科潘王權對奇里瓜的宗主控制，與奇里瓜新王權之間的矛盾。奇里瓜原是科潘的南方附庸，724或725年科潘王把卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特扶上王位，等於在莫塔瓜河谷安插自己的代理人；這位君主即位後卻迅速培植自己的根基，734年9月15日他在祭壇M上自稱神聖之君並開始使用奇里瓜自己的徽記，在瑪雅政治語彙中已是不服舊宗主的表態。736年卡拉克穆爾的瓦馬瓦·卡維爾到訪奇里瓜，遠方強者的到訪使這位年輕君主得到外部支持，也讓科潘感到威脅。深層背景是八世紀瑪雅世界列強格局的變化：卡拉克穆爾在蒂卡爾與科潘之間連續得手，其伸張的一個目標正是爭取莫塔瓜河谷這條連接佩滕與南部高地的商路；而科潘自身在八世紀也已出現王權過度集中、外圍盟邦鬆動的跡象，屬於城邦聯盟體系內的壓力傳導。於是一次外交結盟加一次稱號革命，最後落成一條路上的伏擊。至於科潘王為何會在那一時機離開都城，專家提出的推測是：他可能正率隊前往攻擊另一座城邦以取得可獻祭的俘虜，途中遭奇里瓜伏擊。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the friction between Copán's overlordship over Quiriguá and the new kingship at Quiriguá itself. Quiriguá had been a southern dependency of Copán, and in 724 or 725 the Copán king put K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat on its throne, effectively planting his own agent in the Motagua valley; the new ruler quickly built his own base instead, and on 15 September 734 he set up Altar M, called himself k'uhul ajaw and began to use Quiriguá's own emblem glyph, which in Maya political vocabulary was already a statement of insubordination. When Wamaw K'awiil of Calakmul visited Quiriguá in 736, a distant power lent the young king external backing and made Copán feel the threat. The deeper background is the shift in the balance of the eighth-century Maya world: Calakmul had been scoring success over both Tikal and Copán, and one of its objects was the Motagua valley route, the commercial artery linking the Petén to the southern highlands; Copán itself in the eighth century showed signs of over-centralised kingship and of loosening peripheral allies, the kind of pressure that a city-state league transmits. A diplomatic alliance and a revolution in titulature thus ended in an ambush on a road. As for why the Copán king was away from his capital at that moment, the specialist explanation is that he may have been leading a force against another city-state in order to take captives for sacrifice, and was ambushed on the way.
impact: 738年的結果改寫了南部瑪雅的政治地圖。科潘失去對莫塔瓜河谷的控制，其宗主地位由奇里瓜接替；奇里瓜把自己的首都地位建立在這條貿易走廊上，大廣場西側的市場區與河運泊位都是這套新秩序的設施。科潘則陷入十七年的紀年空白，從738年到755年，其王室連續性被打斷，學界認為這段時期科潘可能處於奇里瓜的支配之下。奇里瓜隨即開啟大規模造像工程，風格幾乎逐件複製科潘，連石塊的運送與開鑿工序都與科潘碑石相似，暗示有科潘的雕刻匠人被徵用；約750年的金印王之牆、761年的聖石F與771年的聖石E把這段建基史刻成國家敘事。717年被科潘攻燒的克庫伊在738年後轉為奇里瓜的忠順附庸，762年由奇里瓜君主主持該城的王位交接，說明奇里瓜接手了科潘的宗屬網絡。從更長的視角看，738年後南部低地的繁榮維持不到一代人：九世紀末莫塔瓜的商路中斷，奇里瓜在810年之後再無新刻的象形文字，城市很快被放棄；科潘谷地同樣衰落，遺址在十世紀初廢棄，後來由伊察人重新佔用。學界至今仍在爭議奇里瓜聖石E是否記載了對科潘王的散布儀式，爭議焦點是：三百多年前提卡爾的西亞胡·卡維爾一世是否被以同一方式對待。若此說成立，738年就不只是一場邊境戰役，而是南部瑪雅把俘獲並重演儀式這一政治暴力傳統再度制度化。
impactEn: The result of 738 redrew the political map of the southern Maya. Copán lost control of the Motagua valley and its position as overlord was taken over by Quiriguá; the new capital of Quiriguá was built on that trade corridor, and the market area on the west side of the Great Plaza and the riverside landing place belong to that new order. Copán fell into a seventeen-year gap in its dated record, from 738 to 755, its dynastic continuity broken, and scholars hold that the city may have lain under Quiriguá's domination during those years. Quiriguá then entered a large monumental programme whose style copies Copán piece by piece, the blocks even being moved and dressed by the same methods as the Copán stelae, which suggests that captured Copán sculptors were set to work; the K'inich Ahau Wall of around 750, Stela F of 761 and Stela E of 771 turned that foundation story into state narrative. Xkuy, burned by Copán in 717, became a loyal dependency of Quiriguá after 738, and in 762 the Quiriguá ruler presided over the transfer of that city's throne, which shows Quiriguá taking over Copán's network of clients. From a longer view, the prosperity of the southern lowlands after 738 did not last a single generation: when the Motagua trade broke down in the ninth century no new hieroglyphic text was raised at Quiriguá after 810, and the city was soon abandoned; the Copán valley declined as well, the site falling out of use by the early tenth century and later being reoccupied by the Itza. Scholars still debate whether the Stela E of Quiriguá records a scattering rite performed on the Copán king, the point at issue being whether Siyaj Chan K'awiil I of Tikal had been treated in the same way some three hundred years earlier. If that reading holds, 738 was not a border skirmish but a case of the southern Maya institutionalising once again the political violence of capture followed by the replay of the rite.
result: 結局對奇里瓜而言是清楚的：卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特俘獲了科潘國王瓦克薩克拉洪·烏巴·卡維爾，將其帶回大廣場，於738年5月3日公開斬首獻祭，科潘守護神的木像同時被毀。奇里瓜沒有攻入科潘城，也沒有留下攻城戰的痕跡，其收穫是莫塔瓜河谷的商路、科潘的附庸網絡，以及南部瑪雅的新宗主地位；科潘則失去王室的連續性與十七年的紀年。戰役的軍事結果因此是一次成功的伏擊加一次成功的政治處決，而不是會戰的勝負；雙方的實際兵力損失無從量化，碑銘只記下被俘者的身份、日期與儀式。餘下的變數在更高層面：奇里瓜的強盛建立在莫塔瓜貿易之上，而這條貿易在九世紀崩潰，於是這份新得來的優勢隨之失效；810年科潘王亞什·帕薩赫·錢·約帕特仍能造訪奇里瓜行卡吞結算禮，但此後奇里瓜再無新刻紀年。卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特於785年7月27日去世，死後第十日入葬十三瓦卡克之家，被認為是其一子的天空舒爾在七十八日後繼位；再往後，兩座城邦都捲入古典期的崩解。就卡面上的科林斯青銅盔而言，它代表的是另一個半球的技術譜系：地中海在公元前650年前後靠整塊青銅殼體解決頭部防護，而738年的中美洲戰士面對同樣的問題，用的是紙、藤、羽毛與獸皮。這件器物在這場戰役裡沒有、也不可能出現在戰線上，它留在卡面上，提醒的是武器如何綁定在各自的材料與社會之中。
resultEn: The outcome was clear from Quiriguá's side: K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat captured Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil of Copán, carried him back to the Great Plaza and had him beheaded in public sacrifice on 3 May 738, while the wooden images of Copán's patron deities were destroyed. Quiriguá did not enter Copán and left no trace of a siege; what it gained was the Motagua trade route, Copán's network of clients and the overlordship of the southern Maya, while Copán lost the continuity of its dynasty and seventeen years of its dated record. The military outcome was therefore a successful ambush and a successful political execution rather than the result of a pitched battle; the actual losses on both sides cannot be quantified, since the inscriptions record only the identity of the captive, the dates and the rite. The remaining variables lie on a larger scale: Quiriguá's new strength rested on the Motagua trade, and when that trade collapsed in the ninth century the advantage expired with it; in 810 the Copán king Yax Pasaj Chan Yopaat could still visit Quiriguá to perform a k'atun-ending rite, but after that no new dated monument was raised there. K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat died on 27 July 785 and was buried ten days later in the Thirteen Kawak House; Sky Xul, thought to be his son, succeeded him seventy-eight days later, and after that both cities were drawn into the Classic collapse. As for the Corinthian helmet on the card, it belongs to a different hemisphere's technical lineage: the Mediterranean solved cranial protection with a single bronze shell around 650 BC, while the warriors of Mesoamerica in 738 faced the same problem with paper, vine, feather and hide. The object never stood on this battlefield and could not have done so; it stays on the card as a reminder that weapons are bound to their own materials and societies.
